articleTitle: Low-cost Remote Lab on Renewable Energy Sources with a Focus on STEM Education
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In the recent years STEM education is becoming an important part of primary and secondary school education. This study presents the development of a remote laboratory in the field of renewable energy sources, aimed for application in secondary schools. The study substantiates the necessity and the applicability of such approach in regards with the current syllabus and regulatory framework. Next, the implementation of the low-cost remote lab is presented and instructions for its application are developed. The study also presents the usage scenarios of the lab for the different physics classes from a regulatory and from a pedagogical perspective.

articleTitle: Approaches for Efficiency Improvement of the Charging Process in an Autonomous Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper several approaches are presented and studied for achieving higher efficiency of the charging process. Based on a patent-protected methodology, four block diagrams are synthesized, and the methodology is implemented in an autonomous PV system.

articleTitle: Comparison of Hybrid Models for PV Power Output Forecasting — Application to Oryahovo, Bulgaria
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents a comparison of different hybrid models used for PV power output forecasting. The models are hybrid, because they use combination of solar radiation forecasting model and power output estimation model. The prediction precision is studied on two time periods – three and six days with different type of solar radiation. The relative root mean square error is used for estimation of the precision. The investigated models show good correlation to the real PV power and can be applied in the exploitation of a PV plant according to the available data.

articleTitle: Study on Power Consumption Modes and Power Quality According to IEEE1459 Standard in the Electric Power Supply Systems Of Public Buildings
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This article presents an analysis of the electricity consumption modes of a public service building, against the IEEE 1459 standard. The essential role of the IEEE 1459 standard is to present the definitions and understandings for evaluating the quality of electric power consumption; for the design of measuring instruments; for the development of measuring methods and algorithms. The main task of the research is to check the quality indicators of electric energy for end users at low voltage level (<tex>$\mathrm{U}=400\mathrm{V}$</tex>) in electrical power supply system of public buildings. The object of the study is the internal electric power supply system of the campus of the Technical University - Varna, Bulgaria. The results of the research can be used in the analysis of other similar public buildings.

Author Keywords: the quality indicators of electrical energy

articleTitle: Control Algorithm Development of Electrical Drives by Using Finite Element Model in Connected MATLAB/Simulink and JMAG Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This study presents a control algorithm development framework for electrical drives. In the proposed framework, MATLAB/Simulink and JMAG software are connected. Hence, the control algorithms under development can be investigated by simulations using a finite element process model. It provides a more accurate electromagnetic description than the lumped parameter type models. Therefore, the anisotropies of the machines can be considered during the development process of control algorithms. To demonstrate the application of the proposed framework, a simulation study on a controlled induction machine drive is presented.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Magnitude of the Electromagnetic Fields in Specific Working Areas of the Electrical Personnel on Vessels with Electric Propulsion
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Electrical personnel on ships have to work in narrow spaces, surrounded by various types of electrical equipment operating at different voltages and currents. As a result of the operation of all systems powered by the ship's electrical installation, electromagnetic fields of various frequencies are generated, including those from the radio-communication and navigation equipment. The aim of the paper is to study the EMFs with low frequency (60 Hz) in specific working areas on a passenger ship with electric propulsion drives in order to assess the occupational safety of the electrical personnel on board.

articleTitle: Technical Economic Analysis of Utilization of Transformers Along a Long Low Voltage Overhead Power Line
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this article, we present a techno-economic analysis of a method to improve the quality of electrical energy in long low-voltage electrical networks, through a system of step-up 0.4/0.95 kV and step-down 0.95/0.4 kV transformers. A model for determining the profitability of the investment through an economic objective function is proposed. An example of its application is presented.

articleTitle: Design for Sustainable Behavior: A Focus on Sustainable Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The world is facing an ever-growing demand for energy, leading to a global shift towards sustainable energy sources. The attempt to lessen our reliance on fossil fuels has made the use of clean energy supplies, like sunlight and wind power, increasingly crucial. There is still plenty of task to be done. For making the best possible use of those commodities' capabilities. This article will explore how use of behavior design to promote sustainable behavior and encourage the uptake of renewable energy sources.

articleTitle: Application of Vibrodiagnostics for Diagnosis and Analysis of Defects Caused by the Flow of Bearing Currents in Electrical Drives
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: One of the frequent problems with electric machines is the presence of bearing currents, leading to bearing defects. The reason for the appearance of these currents is the application of electronic converters in electric drive systems. Bearing defects can be diagnosed by vibration monitoring, when adequate diagnostic techniques are applied. The purpose of this paper is to present the possibility of the vibrodiagnostic method for diagnosis and analysis of defects caused by the flow of bearing currents. In this connection, vibration measurements were carried out on two types of drive units. The obtained results for vibration velocity and enveloping acceleration are compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Application of Hybrid Inverters in Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Photovoltaic electricity generation saves worldwide no less than one billion tons of CO<inf>2</inf>, which is equivalent to approximately 3% of annual global emissions, which reached 33 gigatons in 2021. Thus, photovoltaics are already a key source of electricity decarbonization and achieving greater diversification in individual regions of the countries. In the present work, the focus is placed on hybrid solar inverters, their specific features, principle of operation, and advantages. Application of hybrid inverters in photovoltaic systems for energy self-consumption will be discussed more in detail by presenting a case study of such systems.

articleTitle: Application of Project-Based Learning in the Digital Electronics Course for Implementing Boolean Functions of Three Arguments with Multiplexers
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents the application of the Project-Based Learning approach in the digital electronics course at the University of Ruse for implementing Boolean functions of three arguments with multiplexers.

articleTitle: Problems with measurement at the borders between electricity transmission and distribution networks in Bulgaria
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The article describes important problems related to the measurement of energy transmitted through the borders of the transmission company and the distribution companies in Bulgaria, as well as through the distribution networks. An efficient approach for their solution is proposed, which simultaneously allows the determination of the transmitted electricity in case of loss of an arbitrary measurement and the easy detection of the electricity thefts. An example of calculation of electrical energy losses in a 110/20 kV substation is presented. Analyses are performed and conclusions are drawn.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study of a Hybrid Excited Claw-Pole Alternator
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper studies the feasibility of a hybrid excited claw-pole alternator, using an analytical method for calculation of magnetic flux in the machine air gap. This study will serve as a preliminary calculation to prove or disprove the feasibility and show the advantages and the disadvantages of the proposed topology. The proposed method permits to assess the area of the permanent magnet that is required to obtain a desired voltage at the machine's terminals at a required speed and to properly size the additional excitation winding. The advantages and disadvantages as well as possible applications are discussed.

articleTitle: Simulation and Experimental Study of Static Torque Characteristics of a 12/8 Three-Phase SRM
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This study presents a simulation and experimental investigation of static torque characteristics of a 12/8 three-phase switched reluctance motor (SRM). The experimental study was carried out by developing an experimental setup to measure the static torque of the machine for different magnitudes of phase current and rotor positions. The simulation results for the magnitude of the static torque are obtained using the finite element analysis method FEM and the software simulator (Infolytica MotorSolve). The simulation and experimental results were compared with a relative error of 5%. The obtained characteristics can be used to design a nonlinear motor model for operation in the MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Research of Asymmetric Magnetoelectric Structures on Substrates
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the study of the magnetoelectric effect in asymmetric magnetoelectric structures on a substrate. The magnetoelectric structure consisted of one layer of piezoelectric PZT with dimensions of <tex>$30\times 10\times 0.5$</tex> mm and one layer of Metglas with a size of one layer of <tex>$30\times 10\times 0.02$</tex> mm was placed on a dielectric substrate. Magnetoelectric elements on the substrate were studied in the frequency range from 0.1 to 54 kHz. The studied asymmetric structures on the substrate can be used in various magnetic field sensors, as well as in energy harvesting devices. High sensitivity and relatively small overall dimensions and weight are the advantages of such structures.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient DC Motor Speed Control Using the Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to synthesize energy-efficient speed control of a DC motor. The genetic algorithm is applied to determine the parameters of a PID controller, a fuzzy PID controller and an LQ regulator. The objective function is the minimum of the mean square error and the minimum of the energy, determining the conflicting requirements for the speed of the transient process and the magnitude of the control action, respectively. The results of the synthesis show that the system with a PID controller and the system with a fuzzy PID controller tuned using a genetic algorithm meet the set quality requirements for the transient process. The system with an LQ regulator tuned with a genetic algorithm meets the set quality requirements for the transient process with 8.32% less power consumption compared to the other two systems.

articleTitle: Study of Converters for Energy Storage Systems in Parallel Operation of Modules or Elements
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Energy storage systems use electrical converters for charging and discharging energy storage elements. In order to obtain greater power of the converters, parallel operation of units is used. For application at high input voltages, converters connected in series along the input are used. The converters are most often resonant converters operating on a common load and with dephased controls - multiphase systems. The paper presents investigate different configurations of connecting converters or elements to obtain a certain power output by using elements or units with less power. Simulation results are shown.

articleTitle: Braking Modes Energy Utilization in DC Public Transportation
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: An assessment was made of the possibilities for utilization of the energy stored in the moving masses in DC public transportation. It can be utilized during regenerative regimes of traction motors. The processes of braking and downhill movement of the vehicles are modelled. By integrating the extracted power, the energy recovery potential and the efficiency of a possible hybrid storage system have been evaluated.

articleTitle: Concept for Improving the Lighting Environment and Reducing UGR with Dimmable LEDs System in Sports Hall in Lighting Class III
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The report presents a concept for the reconstruction of lighting systems in small sports halls with the use of dimmable LED's, through which the following results can be achieved: energy-efficient lighting, meeting the requirements for a light environment according to the standard EN 12193: 2019 “Light and lighting - Sports lighting”; a technical solution with minimal investment value with minimal construction and installation activities; technical solution with minimal maintenance complexity and high production guarantees. The research includes application of the concept in the modernization of the lighting system of a sports hall - class III at the Technical University-Varna. An essential part of the task is achievement of low values of the unified glare and discomfort index UGR, which is a significant problem in LED lighting.[1]–[3]. As a result of the technical solution, an electrical energy saving of over 75% was achieved compared to the previous technical solution.

articleTitle: Analysis of LoRa RSSI Data Using Simulations and Real Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: To thoroughly investigate the performance of LoRa networks in the context of the Internet of Things (IoT), it is crucial to employ both simulation models and real-world deployments. In order to validate the accuracy of simulation outputs, a comparison between simulated and real data is necessary. This paper compares the Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) data obtained from both simulated and real-world LoRa networks. A simulation tool for RSSI in LoRa networks is proposed based on the standard. The comparison of the simulated data with a real-built network with LoRa devices shows the applicability of the proposed simulator.

articleTitle: Design of Digital Phase Filters Using MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Digital phase (all-pass) filters are widely used in the field of communications. This paper presents the basic relationships and characteristics of digital all-pass filters, such as magnitude and phase responses. The main applications of digital all-pass filters in communications are listed in the paper and one of them – building a notch filter based on the lattice structure of an all-pass filter is described in detail. The influence of the reflection coefficients on the filter's characteristics is considered in this paper.

articleTitle: Identifying Differences between Power System of Conventional and Autonomous Ship with Respect to their Safety Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Digitalization, artificial intelligence, and awareness of climate change are the driving forces behind the rapid development of the transportation industry. The maritime sector is exploring the applicability of alternative powering options and ways to implement new technologies to increase safety and efficiency, to meet the regulations set by the International Maritime Organisation (IMO), and growth of the seaborne trade. Autonomous shipping is recognized by IMO as a path toward the implementation of new technologies with benefits in terms of safety, costs, and environmental impact. Based on the literature review, a research gap related to design requirements for power systems of autonomous ships is identified. Although the literature indicates that autonomous vessels are expected to be as safe as conventional ones, it is obvious that the removal of the crew from the ship leads to savings in operative costs, but at the same time, it significantly reduces the possibility for corrective maintenance during the voyage. Therefore, it is necessary to analyse key activities of the crew related to the operation of the ship power system and to define the effect of lack of crew on potential safety reductions. This paper aims to analyse differences between the power systems of conventional and autonomous ships and their role in safety assessment, as well as to provide a set of solutions for a successful transition from manned to unmanned ship power systems.

articleTitle: Analytical and Simulation Study of the Power Losses of a Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents an analytical and simulation study of power losses in a switched reluctance motor. A detailed analysis of different types of losses in switched reluctance motors and their causes has been carried out. A non-linear model of a three-phase 12/8 SRM is structured for the MATLAB/Simulink environment, in which additional blocks calculate and visualize motor steel losses, mechanical friction power losses, stator windings active losses, motor total losses, etc. A comparative analysis was carried out between the analytical results and the simulation results.

articleTitle: The Development of an Universal Six Leg Inverter for Electrical Drives Laboratory Experiments
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: To set-up an educational electric drives laboratory with industrial motors, power electronics is required, not only for control, but also for regenerating the drive energy. Undergraduate and graduate students can first practice the behavior of the electric drive in simulation. After passing the simulation experiments, the students can repeat the experiments on the experimental set-up. After estimating and testing the control parameters in simulation, the experimental set-up can be supplied with those parameters. The bidirectional power-flow in a dual motor set-up, has to be regenerative. For this, an experimental set-up containing two back to back coupled inverters, with common DC bus, was developed. In the paper, the design of the experimental set-up is outlined, together with typical measurement results from the set-up. The application of interchangeable gate-drivers, currents-sense and isolated power-supplies is detailed, required for fast repairs or changing components.

articleTitle: Magnonic Commutator on Magnetoelectric Gradient Structure for Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Spin waves and waveguides is a hot topic of modern research. The presence of low losses makes it possible to consider them as candidates of information carries for artificial neural networks. By analogy with artificial dielectrics, in which artificial dielectric inhomogeneity sets the direction of electromagnetic field passage, the introduction of a magnetic inhomogeneity makes it possible to turn the front of the spin wave. The magnonic commutator model is considered in a research paper, which consist of a layered magnetoelectric gradient structure. The effects present in these structures make it possible to electronically control the turn of the spin wave.

articleTitle: Web-based Information Portal for Business Partners - Basis for Professional Guidance for Graduates
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: University career centres play an important role in orienting students into the possibilities of starting a professional career. Even in the initial years of their studies, meetings company executives and attending company presentations can lead to increased interest and motivation of students to make more efforts to acquire knowledge in a chosen field. This role becomes even more important in the conditions of the dynamically changing labour market and the prospects for the disappearance of a large number of professions at the expense of emerging new ones due to advances in areas such as artificial intelligence, medicine, green and renewable energy sources, etc. Even more important is the possibility of a timely and focused connection between businesses as users of the highly qualified workforce, produced by universities, and those studying in them. Career centres can play a key role in this communication, but for this purpose they must be well provided, not least with information systems with specific functionalities. The most natural choice is for these systems to be web-based. This report describes various aspects of such a system.

articleTitle: Classification of Factors Affecting Employee Satisfaction in Modern Business Organizations
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The influence of employee satisfaction on team performance remains a crucial issue for both managers and employees in modern business organizations. This paper adds to the theoretical debate on managing effective and motivated teams by classifying the main factor groups to impact employee satisfaction and discusses their relationships with employee performance and team effectiveness.

articleTitle: Educational Power Logger for Electrical Machines Laboratory Experiments
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Measurements in electrical machines and drives laboratory for undergraduate and graduate courses are mostly carried out using dedicated oscilloscopes. Important in electric drive experiments, is the visualization of three-phase voltages and currents. However, visualization of two-phase vector quantities is more intuitive, especially when displayed as two-dimensional graphs. A hexagon showing the voltage vector and circle showing the current is more intuitive, than six sinusoidal waveforms. In this paper a low-cost measurement device is presented, for direct transformation of the three-phase voltages and currents into two-phase signals that can be displayed on a XY-oscilloscope.

articleTitle: Design of an Electronic System for Regeneration of Potential-Induced Degradation (PID) in PV Installations
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The efficiency of photovoltaic modules greatly depends on different types of degradation, one of which is known as potential-induced degradation (PID). In this study is proposed and designed an electronic system for regeneration of PID, without the need to disconnect the modules for maintenance. It contains a master module and numerous IoT nodes, located at each PV module, which are responsible for the reconfiguration of the strings. It is suggested that the communication between the modules could be implemented wirelessly, with LoRa or other appropriate for the situation technology. The study also presents the operation algorithm of the IoT nodes and the activity diagram of the system as a whole. Finally, three scenarios for the exploitation of such system are defined and their advantages and disadvantages are analyzed. The proposed electronic system could be useful for the owners of PV installation, as it would allow them to reduce the degradation of the photovoltaic installations, which would increase the produced energy in the long run.

articleTitle: Applying a Problem-based Learning in the Topic of Modelling of the Power and Improvement the Voltage Stability of Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The manuscript presents an approach to applying problem-based learning in teaching students of engineering disciplines in studying the processes related to the production of electrical energy from wind generators and the possibilities for improving the quality of the produced electrical energy. One exercise for training the students with the help of a Simulink block diagram is analyzed. The synthesized model is adaptive and makes it very easy to change the number of generators and their nominal power, etc. It has been established that the use of appropriate digitization tools and the presentation of learning content combined with interactive presentations creates conditions for personalizing the learning process, supports creative thinking, and increases the interest of students and teachers in general. In the simulation, the students investigate the effect of applying transverse reactive power compensation when connecting the static synchronous compensator to the power grid under various transient disturbances and the response of the system compared to that obtained without the compensator. The obtained results show that the application of problem-based learning methods and virtual laboratories is suitable for students of engineering disciplines.

articleTitle: Social Inequility and Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This report addresses certain relationships between the levels of social inequality in countries and the results of the implementation of certain elements of the sustainable development policy - solving environmental problems, implementing innovations, social responsibility.

articleTitle: Electric Osmosis in Heat Pipes
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the research of electroosmosis in porous and capillary systems. The authors consider the main applications of electroosmosis. The paper presents the results of the practical implementation of electroosmotic pumps used in cooling systems. The prospects for the use of electroosmosis in heat pipes were considered in the conclusion.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of the Temperature Field of an Electronic Module
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The thermal performance of electronic modules is of significant importance for their reliability and long service. In the present study is performed experimental investigation of the temperature field of a test module with the aim to obtain different physical parameters of the PCB and then perform thermal simulations. Initially an experimental setup is used, which allows to classify the temperature field of the electronic device into several zones (categories) as a function of time. Thereafter, these experimental results were used to obtain the area of each zone, its temperature response, the heat transfer coefficient, etc. Next, different simulations were performed with the use of a specially developed simulation tool. It allows to investigate the temperature response of the module under different environmental and constructional parameters. The obtained results allow to create an informational database, allowing the simulation of the temperature field of electronic modules.

articleTitle: Application of IoT in Upgrading Automatic Control of Rope-Poly-Strap Lifting Systems for Cranes and Rotary Excavators
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In order to meet the criteria of sustainability through reduced harmful emissions, and social and economic well-being, it is necessary to modernize the infrastructure and technical means not only in all spheres of life but also in the mining industry. For this purpose, the article examines the state of hoisting polyspaston rope systems for cranes and bucket-wheel rotary excavators and proposes an updated system for their management based on IoT. After researching innovative experimental and practical methods, it was found that a secure control system with wireless data transmission and low energy consumption is suitable for harsh working conditions. After the inspection and analysis of the current situation, an option for implementing remote control and strain gauges is proposed. Various platforms such as ZigBee, BLE, LoRa, and Wi-Fi were considered. Wi-Fi was chosen as the transport medium according to bandwidth, distance, data rate, power consumption, and security.

articleTitle: Applying a Recurrent Neural Network to the Behaviour of an Autonomous Agent
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This manuscript focuses on the application of deep recurrent learning techniques to build rational behaviour of an autonomous agent. The purpose of this study is to compare the encoder-decoder learning approach and classical Recurrent Neural Networks. The main hypothesis is that the encoder-decoder deep learning method is applicable in the area of sequential games and demonstrates better performance than classical Markov Deterministic Process learning. Thus, intelligent agents with a consistent approach can find better solutions to problems. in addition, in this manuscript, additional emphasis is placed on the training process in a dynamic sequential game environment.

articleTitle: Study of the Longitudinal Dynamic Parameters of Two Wheel Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In the last few years, the use of electric scooters in Bulgaria has increased significantly. Along with the positives, this has also led to some road safety issues. Road traffic safety and the expert investigation of accidents are particularly relevant for Bulgaria now. This work presents modern results on the longitudinal dynamics parameters of electric scooters, obtained in real road conditions. Such information is missing in Bulgarian literature. The results obtained on the accelerations and decelerations of these vehicles can be very useful in investigating the possibilities of preventing traffic accidents.

articleTitle: A MTTFd Estimation Approach for Electronic Modules Part of Safety-Related Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper an approach is presented to assess the probability of occurrence of “dangerous” failures. Criteria have been formulated for evaluating the nature of possible failures, as well as individual functional blocks for the operation of the control system.

articleTitle: Hybrid Energy Storage System To Increase Energy Efficiency During Regenerative Braking Of Urban Electrical Transport
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: A case study on the possibilities to increase energy efficiency during regenerative braking of public urban electrical transport (PUET) of Sofia by utilization of hybrid energy storage system (HESS), comprised primarily of supercapacitors, is presented in this paper. A HESS can be applied to increase energy savings and efficiency, and improve power quality. With the utilization of HESS during regenerative braking the energy can be stored and to be extracted afterwards back into the overhead catenary to supply travelling PUET vehicles. The utilization of supercapacitors as on-board storage devices has been proven on electrical buses. However, in the case of trolleybuses and trams it is not the case which presents the question of installing HESS in substations. In addition, the potential of utilizing photovoltaic (PV) installations to further reduce costs is explored. Based on obtained results regenerative braking is primarily occurring during a full stop and less whenever descending. Thus, the estimated energy capacity that is meaningful to be stored in HESS is rather small. Furthermore, estimated utilization of PV's can reduce energy costs by up to 13 %. Nevertheless, increasing efficiency of public transport is beneficial to society itself and cannot be compared to an economic profit.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Photobiological Impact of LED Light Sources in the Context of Standardization Requirements for Reduction of Blue Light Emission
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The report examines the photobiological impact and, in particular, the emission of blue light from LED sources according to IEC (EN) 60598-1:2020 “Luminaires - Part 1: General requirements and tests” and EN 62471:2009 “Photobiological safety of lamps and lamp system”. Visible light in the range 380 to 770 nm with a higher content of blue light can have a negative impact on biological circadian rhythms associated with larger changes such as “day and night”, which inevitably has a direct impact on the psychological, the physiological, and in some cases the health condition of a human. The light sources with a high color temperature excite the hormone cortisol, called the hormone of stress, and those with low levels of color temperature (warm colors) excite the hormone melatonin, called the hormone of sleep. These dependencies are well known and they are used in the selection of sources with optimal color temperature depending on the work activities in the premises. A significant interest is the question regarding the achievment of different color temperatures with different percenttage composition of blue light, which represents a direct health hazard due to the possibility of accelerated damage to the retina of the human eye [1]–[3].

articleTitle: Backstepping Control of a Phase Shifted Full Bridge DC/DC Converter for EV Fast Chargers
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper introduces a new and innovative control approach for the Phase Shifted Full Bridge (PSFB) converter, which is a key component of electric vehicle fast charging stations. The research first establishes a mathematical model of the isolated converter, followed by the development of a backstepping control method that effectively addresses the challenge of nonlinear control during charging. To demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed controller, a comparison with the conventional Proportional Integral (PI) control strategy is carried out. Moreover, simulation results under complex cases clearly illustrate the superior response time, robustness, and dynamic performance of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Implementation of PLC-based Cooling system control of an industrial hall where a large amount of heat is emitted
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The present paper considers the operation of an implemented original PLC-based cooling system control of an industrial hall where a large amount of heat is emitted. A description of the system, its principle of operation, its features and advantages are presented.

articleTitle: Calculation of Temperature Distribution at Cable Joints Using Hybrid Boundary Elements Method
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In addition to the strength of the electric field, the reliability and robustness of electrical cable networks is also affected by the temperature that exists in the places where the internal and external conductors of a cable are connected. Also, unequable distribution of electric field and temperature leads to rapid aging of cable equipment. Hybrid Boundary Elements Method (HBEM) was used in order to precisely calculate and detect the places where maximum values of the EM field and temperature are higher than critical values, reduce the undesirable temperature level of the cable connection. This paper shows the distribution of electro-thermal fields in power cable joints using HBEM. For the calculation of the electric field, equivalent electrodes and equivalent point charge source are used, while for the calculation of the thermal field, equivalent volumetric heat sources are used.

articleTitle: Comparison of Extended and Unscented Kalman Filters with and without Using Mechanical Model for Speed Sensorless Control of Induction Machines
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this work, speed sensorless state estimators are compared for induction machine drives. The studied estimators are based on two widely used state-space models. The first one has five state variables and assumes slowly varying rotor speed. In contrast, the second model is augmented by the equation of motion and the load torque is defined as an additional state variable. Due to the nonlinearities, extended and unscented Kalman filters are applied in the case of both models. To compare the parameter sensitivities and the low speed operation of the four state estimators, simulations and experiments are carried out. In addition, the estimators are also tested in speed sensorless closed-loop control structure.

articleTitle: Design of Multiple-Output Flyback Converter with Independently Controlled Outputs for TV Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents the design of a multiple-output flyback converter (MOFC) for a television power supply system. The proposed converter is capable of independently controlling the output voltage of multiple power rails, allowing for efficient and precise power delivery to various subsystems within the TV. The backlight LEDs' current and system supply voltage is controlled independently and the backlight LEDs are fed from the same flyback transformer directly, so there is no need for a buck or boost converter stage. The system voltage of 12V is regulated by the extra N-MOSFET. By eliminating the need for an additional converter stage and adopting smaller transformer sizes, this design not only reduces card sizes and cost but also leads to significant improvements in peak efficiency and power density. The proposed MOFC is explained in details together with the simulation and measurement results.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Generating Human Eye Iris Texture Code
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper describes two algorithms developed for extracting iris texture data. The purpose of the development is to compare the coding algorithms and select the one that gives the best results. A method for optimal data encoding is also described. Given an image texture, code is obtained that is in a format suitable for comparison and storage. The software product used for image processing and algorithm implementation is MATLAB.

articleTitle: Application of Convolutional Neural Networks and Signal Processing Techniques to Identify and Filter Noise from ECG Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This study explores the use of convolutional neural networks (CNN) and different signal processing techniques to identify and filter noise from ECG signals. The study evaluates the performance of different filtering methods like Butterworth, Chebyshev type II, and Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) on synthetic ECG signals with added noise from three primary sources - baseline drift, electrode motion artifacts, and skeletal muscle interference. A CNN-based categorization system is developed to detect the presence of noise and select the appropriate filtering method. The study concludes by evaluating the effectiveness of these filtering techniques in improving the ECG signal quality and reducing noise. The study shows that wavelet filtering and Chebyshev filter of the 2nd type are effective methods to remove noise from ECG signals.

articleTitle: 3D Printed Designs for Permanent Magnets Fixation on High Speed Rotors
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this work are presented 3D printed designs for permanent magnets fixation on movable rotors. Fused Filament Fabrication 3D printing technology by polymer magnetic and non-magnetic materials is used. Four types of magnets fixation designs are considered. These are: prismatic surface design – glued or screwed; partially buried magnets with edge fixed magnets design; and fully buried magnets design. Each different design is estimated by initial formal analysis and promising design for 3D printing are prototyped. The prototyped design magnetic flux reluctance is estimated, caused by added fixation elements over the rotor. Reluctance is estimated by finite element method modeling. Material usage during 3D printing is also considered in the presented research.

articleTitle: Faults Analysis of the Electrical Equipment in a Company from the Mining Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The report gives the results of a study of electrical equipment failures over a period of one year. Fault classification has been made and statistical processing of electrical equipment recovery time data and the distribution law of the recovery time have been determined.

articleTitle: Application of PID algorithms to control robotic platform using Simulink
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The usage of robots in the industry, research and hobby has increased during the years. In the world of academia robots present a perfect test bench for researchers. Many fields like robotics and automatics use them to solve many specific problems. The research area of robots is toward the implementation of new control techniques, new control and machine learning algorithms. Autonomous robots are the main trend in the modern research and industry area. This project is related to the use of MATLAB Simulink in the process of rapid prototyping control algorithms for a robotic platform. The Alphabot2-Pi is used as a research platform. The control algorithms are implemented as software processes started in real-time in the operating system environment of the robot. In this study, Simulink models are developed using standard and non-standard blocks. The system is implemented as the hardware, software and communication tools are used. Simulink toolbox like Embedded Coder is used for automatic code generation, compilation and deploying to the robotic platform. The standard and nonstandard (Fuzzy) PID algorithms are tested to perform and implement the control of the platform steering angle to travel along the specified path. The improvement of PID algorithms is done by varying the coefficients using some heuristic methods. The implementation, configuration and testing of the proposed system capabilities are investigated in a real environment. The study shows that the system, with varying success, is capable of performing the proposed tasks using different control parameters. The results obtained with standard and nonstandard (fuzzy) PID algorithms are satisfactory. Both algorithms solved the proposed task, but the standard PID control algorithm turned out to be better for high-speeds than the fuzzy PID.

articleTitle: Inverter Model Optimization in Simulink Software Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: A model of an inverter with phase control was synthesized in the Matlab/Simulink programming environment. A comparative analysis was made between the operation of the inverter with a phase - controlled algorithm, with an input voltage duty factor of 50% / 50% and 35% / 50%. The active power losses, the total harmonic distortion and harmonic composition of the output voltage and current were determined in the system for two operating modes of the inverter.

articleTitle: Main Characteristics in Measuring Team Communication as a Means of Improving Team Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: A main goal of team communication research is to study in full two key characteristics that make the most significant contribution to team effectiveness. These are the quality and frequency of communication. The present paper examines their relationship with several factor groups, namely openness and respect among members, information sharing, leadership, and the level of team conflict, through which team communication appears to be a major moderator of team functioning.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Flying Inductor Converter Based on Karschny Topology
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents a Karschny-based transformerless inverter topology with a flying inductor to operate in DC-AC and AC-DC mode. Karschny has many advantages such as lack of transformer, no leakage current, simple design, high efficiency, high reliability and low price and small size. It is a common implementation choice for DC-AC inverters, but in the recent years, the interest of bidirectional topologies increase rapidly and the goal of this study is to propose design improvement which will allow the bidirectional operation of Karschny topology.

articleTitle: Theoretical Model for Evaluation of the Energy Efficiency of a Home Bread Maker
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: An analytical model is presented of the heat energy consumption during the process of making bread by means of a home bread maker. The relationship is formulated between heat consumption and the weight of the finished product, the temperature of the initial mixture and the temperature of the dough for home bread making. The model was tested in real conditions by using a home bread maker whose efficiency was calculated while operating in its standard operation program.

articleTitle: Application of a Methodology for the Design and Construction of Power Chokes for Low Voltage Filter-Compensating Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents the results from application of a methodology for the design of a power choke for low voltage filter-compensating systems. The main task of the study is to demonstrate the workability of a practical methodology for the construction and realization of a specialized product - a power choke, applicable to filter-compensating systems, detuning reactors for capacitor batteries, TCSC-type power compensators, compensating reactors, etc. The synthesized methodology was used in the development of a physical model of a choke with adjustable power 2-10 kVAr (400V, Y connection circuit) by changing the air gap and with discrete steps of windings - 25, 50, 75 and 100%. The report presents comparative analysis of choke parameters, achieved from the design methodology and the physical model produced by Elprom EMZ Ltd., Bulgaria.

articleTitle: Low-cost tester for start-up and hold-up verification of electronic converters
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents an economically efficient solution that can be used alongside conventional laboratory power supply units in order to test switch-mode power supplies inrush current handling and hold-up time. The solution provides fast switch-on and off times with the high dv/dt for testing inrush current handling and programmable turn-off times for testing hold-up times. The suggested topology acts as an upgrade to existing laboratory equipment and can to some extend replace complex and expensive power supplies that have the aforementioned testing capability integrated. The proposed topology is tested and verified where some of the most notable results are presented.

articleTitle: System for String Monitoring in small Experimental PV Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents a system for real-time measurement of electrical and physical parameters of a small (12kWp) photovoltaic power plant. This experimental photovoltaic installation is located in the urban area of Ruse, on the territory of the University of Ruse. A system was designed that measures the energy produced by each solar array in shaded locations commonly found in urban environments, as well as environment parameters, solar radiation, PV cell temperature and even infrared images of the facility. The collected data will be used to model and forecast energy production from solar panels under urban conditions.

articleTitle: External Rotor BLDC Motor Design for a Light Electric Vehicle: 24 Slot/22 Pole Combination
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: An external rotor brushless direct current (BLDC) motor for a light electric vehicle (EV) was designed in this study. The slot/pole ratio was chosen as 24/22 and the power of the motor is 2 kW. Motor's boundary dimensions, magnet thickness, stator winding type, number of winding turns, stator tooth structure, and tooth thickness were determined. Electromagnetic analyses were performed to determine the optimal design, and motor output values were verified. Rated output torque and rated output speed were achieved 17.27 Nm and 1105 rpm respectively. After the cover, body, and shaft designs were completed in accordance with the final design, the motor prototype was produced.

articleTitle: Analysis of Students Satisfaction with Distance Learning and the Advantages and Disadvantages of Laboratory Works with Computer Simulation of Electronic Analog Circuits
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The analysis of students satisfaction with distance learning during COVID-19 pandemic by surveying responders was done. The survey contains questions on the advantages and disadvantages, the problems and recommendations for improving distance learning. At the result it became clear that most students like to study in a blended learning format. This research shows the attitude of students to online learning, communication skills, technical and social aspects of distance learning. Also the differences between the laboratories based on computer simulation of electric circuit and the bench laboratory were analyzed and the advantages and disadvantages of the computer simulation laboratory were established. There were two focus groups of students for analyzing the level of students after their work with the bench and computer simulation laboratories. The testing shows that if a student additionally works with computer simulation program, his level of education increases. Computer simulation work can be important and the level of knowledge of students has increased.

articleTitle: Implementation of a complex PLC-based control of the technological systems of a sports center with a swimming pool
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The present paper considers the operation of an implemented original PLC-based control of the technological systems of a sports center with a swimming pool. A description of the system, its principle of operation, its features and advantages are presented.

articleTitle: Application of SWOT Analysis for the Selection of a Hybrid System for Heating and Production of Energy and Hot Water for the Conditions of Bulgaria
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The article outlines the advantages and disadvantages of different heating sources. Given the requirements for reduced carbon emissions, modern technical means of heating such as heat pumps and hybrid systems have been analyzed. Their advantage is that they are energy efficient and can work with various energy sources, including solar energy. At the same time, they serve not only for heating and production of hot water but also for energy. Considering factors such as climatic conditions, installation cost, maintenance cost, and others, it can be seen that choosing a particular heating system is difficult. Therefore, the work has developed a SWOT analysis for three main systems in order to facilitate the choice of users.

articleTitle: Considerations on Electromagnetic Disturbances Appearing in Electrical Energy Smart Metering Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper, the authors present a review of a series of issues related to electromagnetic disturbances arising during the transmission of data between the electricity distributor and the final consumer, when using the electricity distribution network. Also, in some representative case studies, the procedures for identifying electromagnetic disturbances that affect this technology are exemplified.

articleTitle: Design of an Electronic System for Control of PV-Powered Irrigation Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this study is presented the design of an electronic system for control of irrigation processes. It is powered by an autonomous PV installation with a battery storage. The electronic system is organized by a master control unit, which collects data about some soil parameters from numerous IoT sensors, as well data from a weather station and the inverter. It controls a water pump and water valves with the use of relays. The decision-making process is implemented using fuzzy logic. It relies on three input parameters: the soil moisture, the solar radiation and the air temperature. The output of the algorithm is the irrigation time required. It is also planned to enhance the decision making with additional input data about the produced PV energy and the available energy in the battery storage, as well as with the necessity for application of fertilizers.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of the Change of Touch and Step Voltages at the Flow of Lightning Currents in Earthing Grids with Different Mesh Sizes
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The flow of lightning current through earthing grids of electrical installations leads to the occurrence of impulse processes in the soil. For practice, it is of interest to determine the potentials in the area of earthing installations and the possible touch and step voltages for assessing the effectiveness of the installation. The object of this research is a comparative analysis of the touch and step voltages of horizontal earthing installations with different cell sizes. An existing simulation model of an earthing installation developed by the authors in previous work was used. The influence of the soil resistivity is considered. Different locations of lightning strikes in the earthing grid were considered for the analysis. The obtained results confirm the recommendations in some regulatory documents to increase the size of the cells from the periphery to the center of the grounding grid.

articleTitle: Estimation of Geomagnetically Induced Currents Affect on Power Grid Based on Measurements of Mid-Latitude Geomagnetic Observatories
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The estimation of geomagnetically induced currents that can affect the power grid system was conducted based on measurements from mid-latitude geomagnetic observatories in this study. To accomplish this, the grid line in the territory of Amaty oblast, Kazakhstan, was selected, and the geophysical conditions in the region were investigated. It was determined that due to geomagnetically active periods, Kazakhstan's energy systems affect by geomagnetically induced currents for a significant duration that depends on the geomagnetic storm value and time of its lasting, with the rate of geomagnetic field changes exceeding 17 nT/min. And the value of the geomagnetically induced currents can vary from fractions of mA to tens of mA.

articleTitle: Simulation Environment for Examining the Pairing Methods in BLE Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) technologies extend into one of 5G layers to monitor and manage connected devices. As 5G expands, so do IoT technologies. They are applied in various areas of modern life, and high-speed communication between connected components is taken care of by new generation technologies. Besides the speed and reliability of transmitted information in IoT networks, one of the key aspects is communication security to ensure a high Quality of Service (QoS). This report presents an improvement to the simulation product developed by the authors. It enables the study of different pairing mechanisms between devices on one of the most common IoT technologies, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE). The pairing mechanisms implemented in the simulation product aim to provide secure communication between connected devices. The purpose of the developed simulator is to provide an environment for researching the considered mechanisms related to security, as well as their presentation during education.

articleTitle: Peltier Module-Based Thermoregulator for Liquid Bidirectional Temperature Control
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Industries and homes often need to keep the liquid container temperature constant or within certain limits. For raising the temperature, a number of technical solutions have been developed, usually involving electric heaters. When it comes to cooling certain fluid, possibilities are greatly reduced and technical solutions become more complicated and limited from a practical point of view. The goal of this paper is to present a project and a prototype of a system for monitoring and maintaining a preset temperature of the water volume. Its thermostatting is carried out by both forced heating and forced cooling. The main task is to completely eliminate the impact of the ambient temperature on the fluid temperature. The proposed solution can be applied to maintain the temperature in aquariums or other similar liquid containers.

articleTitle: Role of the Leader in the Anti-Crisis Management of Energy Sector Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Dynamic changes in the modern economic reality increase the impact of the leadership role in successfully overcoming crises. Leadership styles may be similar but an effective leader must know when and how to apply them. Although leadership styles come to most leaders by default or naturally, they must know how to use their power and authority to lead others and change and adapt to situations to avoid failure. Successful leaders skillfully adjust their style based on specific situations to guide the company to successfully overcome crises. The article presents the application of situational leadership in the anti-crisis management of companies from the energy sector and the key aspects and roles of the leader for preventing crisis situations.

articleTitle: Structures and Topologies for Realization of Charging Station for EVs
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In the current paper basic structures and topologies for implementation in charging stations for electric vehicles are presented. The main purpose of the manuscript is to consider, describe and classify the different types of power supply, energy storage elements and electronic converter in charging stations and in hybrid and electric vehicles. An intelligent methodology for energy management is presented to ensure the necessary power when charging electric vehicles. AC and DC powered architectures for building charging stations are presented. The main advantages and disadvantages of different topologies are described and discussed.

articleTitle: Computer-Based Methods for Student Training in the field of Electricity Supply
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In recent years, modelling methods, microprocessor-based, programmable devices, providing the possibility for communication over various types of interfaces, have been introduced in the field of power supply. The operation of most of the elements being used can be simulated through the use of different, advanced and innovative methods. The efforts of the lecturing staff need to be focused on implementing modern approaches to teaching students, which are implemented with an appropriate elements base and software systems. In this paper, an overview of the basic technical equipment in the field of electricity supply is presented and an approach is proposed for teaching students specialized modules in this field of study. Surveys have been conducted on the students' opinions assessing the applicability of the said approach. An analysis is made showing that the proposed way of learning is adequately and positively received by the trainee students and academic staff.

articleTitle: Difference Between Measured and Real Value in Illuminance Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: When calibration of measuring devices and in particular illuminance meters take place, statistical evidence for the reliability of the procedure must be considered. Calibration process stability should be examined, and control charts should be introduced. The current paper presents three sigma control charts, verifying that the calibration process is under control. They are based on the readings of a precise luxmeter taken in six consecutive years, owned by the Research and Development Laboratory for Lighting Technology in the Technical University of Sofia (R&D Lighting Laboratory). After verification that the calibration process is controlled, X bar R charts for different types of illuminance meters, calibrated within a period of five years are generated. The results obtained show the performance of the measured devices in terms of stability of the sample readings and presence of variations.

articleTitle: On Magnetic Inductions in a Three-Phase Split-Phase Induction Device
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Three-phase induction devices for heating workpieces are characterized by the appearance of a rotating magnetic field. The construction under consideration eliminates this problem, as one of the phases is composed of two coils opposing each other (split phase). However, a phenomenon appears, although the two coils of the split phase have the same parameters, the magnetic inductions in the cores of their magnetic wires differ. The present publication attempts to establish the reason for these differences.

articleTitle: Charging Station Infrastructure and Standards for Electric Vehicles - State, Problems and Future Trends
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In the current paper a review of state problems and future trends in charging stations and the different types of standards and connector type for supplying EVs are presented. Three main types of infrastructure for building charging stations in the home, in public buildings and in offices are reviewed. Optimal methods for managing energy flows to use more green energy are also presented. The main advantages and disadvantages of the presented infrastructures are also presented.

articleTitle: A Model Based Comparison on the Efficiency of Electric Vehicles to Conventional Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: A model based comparison between an electric vehicle (EV) and a conventional vehicle with an internal combustion engine (ICEV) is presented in this paper. The study is performed by use of “Advanced Vehicle Simulator” (ADVISOR) in MATLAB environment. Both types of vehicles are subjected to a New European Driving Cycle (NEDC) procedure and to a combined “city-highway” fuel economy test procedure. As these test procedures are US based ones, it is not explicitly the case in terms of Bulgaria's conditions. Thus, in addition, a comparative fuel economy evaluation is presented. Based on obtained results from ADVISOR, it can be seen that NEDC's nature of fast and aggressive style of driving does not enhance EV's inherent advantages and the necessity of charging infrastructure is vividly exhibited. Emissions' results of simulated ICEV exceed the normative values of hydrocarbons and of particle matters set by US' Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and Europe's EURO 6 standards. However, the simulation done by ADVISOR does not account for emissions reduction techniques. In addition, the fuel consumption and fuel economy evaluation shows that to travel by EV is less expensive. This, however, is a direct comparison of “tank-to-wheel” efficiency of EVs and ICEVs. Whenever “well-to-wheel” efficiency is considered the efficiency with which the primary source of energy to respective vehicle is produced has to be included. That is to say the “well-to-wheel” efficiency is the product of the “tank-to-wheel” efficiency and the efficiency which is known as “well-to-tank”. Then, if an EV is charged with electricity generated by coal-fired power plants its “well-to-wheel” efficiency is similar to the one of ICEVs. Furthermore, albeit ICE's inherent lower efficiency, the accessibility of ICEVs is still widely needed as there are many uncertainties regarding EV's charging purely by spatial point of view at residential complexes. Thus, taking everything below into considerations a complete extinction of any type vehicle seems unlikely and it is more likely that in the future a vehicle diversification comprised of ICEVs, EVs and hybrids will be the standard.

articleTitle: Effect of the Color of the Room Surfaces in a Machine Hall on the Energy Efficiency of the Lighting Installation
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The interconnection between color and light has been a major topic of a lot of research. The current paper aims to analyze the influence of the colors of the surfaces in a space on the energy efficiency of its lighting installation. The real situation in a machine hall in a Waterpower Plant has been investigated. A reconstruction of the lighting conditions has been proposed and the estimation of the possible economy of electrical energy has been calculated in case the surfaces in the premises are painted in different colors. The artistic and architectural recommendations on the influence of the different colors on the psychological reactions of humans and the perception of spaciousness are also considered.

Author Keywords: influence of color on lighting efficiency

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Ozone Generating Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper compares the performance of three types of ozonation devices with different designs and applications. Experimental and theoretical studies on ozonation devices have been carried out in order to make a comparative analysis of the results at different settings of the operation process. The considered designs of ozonators are used in various fields such as medicine, purification facilities and household.

articleTitle: A Remote Lab for Experimental Study of DC Motors
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Remote labs have become an affordable technology in many aspects and as a result is now widely applicable in the universities. This article describes a lab for remote access to a combination of DC motor with DC generator. A fully interactive environment is offered for the remote user and the specialized architecture meets all network requirements in terms of security. Examples of usage of remote laboratories as a part of engineering education is presented. Furthermore, the study presents some results from the application of the developed lab in the Electrical Engineering course, toughed to students from the Mechanical and manufacturing engineering faculty, Agrarian and industrial faculty and Transport faculty.

articleTitle: Modeling the Energy Storage System for Different Forms of Discharge Current
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Usually, the battery condition estimation is done by having information about its capacity. The discharging profile of the battery is the most common way for collecting reliable information for its capacity. The discharging curve shape can be different for same battery depending on the way it is being discharged. This paper describes a look-up table based simulation tool for modeling and determining the State of Charge of a Lithium Ion battery.

articleTitle: Comparative Evaluation of Communication Protocols in the Automotive Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In recent life, the most contemporary communication and information technologies are increasingly used in various areas. One of these areas is the automotive industry. The normal operation of modern vehicles is ensured by multiple Electronic Control Units (ECUs) requiring fast, secure, and reliable communication. This is accomplished using various automotive communication protocols, namely Controller Area Network (CAN), Local Interconnect Network (LIN), FlexRay, Media Oriented Systems Transport (MOST), and Ethernet. This report presents a complex comparative evaluation of these protocols to determine the most suitable one for interconnection with the main ECUs.

articleTitle: Modelling of a DC Generator in Matlab Environment During Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents an approach for the use of simulation models in the Matlab programming environment in the study of DC generators that constitute part of the curriculum of the Electrical Machines Part I module for students of the degree program of Electrical Power Engineering and Electrical Equipment at the Angel Kanchev University of Ruse. The achievements of the students in this module during the transition from face-to-face to online learning are analyzed and the results of the survey conducted among the students are presented.

articleTitle: Determination of the Level of Vibroactivity of the Traction Motor-Gear Units
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: At present, the continuous development of suburban and regional railway communication creates the prerequisites for continuous improvement of the reliability of traction electric drive systems, taking into account the constant increase in loads on actuators. In electric rolling stock, the predominant use of traction electric drives often results in difficult accessibility and maintenance of the actuators once they are installed. Intensive traffic gave impetus to the mass introduction of an asynchronous traction electric drive. The traction electric drive consists of various functional components, and the phenomena taking place within the drive exhibit diverse physical characteristics. These factors necessitate evaluating the present condition of the electrical and mechanical elements of the equipment and monitoring its state during operation. It is recommended to conduct comprehensive tests and acceptance trials during the manufacturing process, particularly for new products and during the inspection phase of mass production.

articleTitle: Simulation Model For Evaluation Of Power Quality Indicators In Industrial Power Supply Systems With Grid-Tied PV System
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents the development of a simulation model for the assessment of power quality indicators in an industrial power supply system with a grid-connected photovoltaic installation. The model allows estimation of current and voltage harmonic distortions under different system operating modes and load configurations, power and type.

articleTitle: Assessment of Operational Reserve Requirement Resulting from Wind Power use in the Electric Power System of Kosovo
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper addresses the assessment of the impact of energy from renewable energy sources on the demand for operational reserves. Generation from wind farms and photovoltaic plants is expected to grow rapidly in Kosovo in the coming years. This study highlights the impact that energy production from these sources will have on system balancing and the demand for operational reserves. The results show the specific trends that renewable generation from solar and especially from wind has in increasing the imbalances. Determining the necessary reserves taking into account the variability and uncertainty of the generation from renewable sources will contribute to the operation of the system in accordance with the required standards. This study provides valuable information for energy operators and planners regarding the dimensioning of balancing reserves as a result of the continuous development of renewable energy generation in Kosovo and similar regions.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Iris Segmentation in Human Eye
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The article presents an algorithm for detecting and separating the iris from other parts of the human eye. Iris detection is performed by sequentially implementing an edge detector and Hough transform for pupil detection and an iris boundary detection algorithm. Overall image segmentation involves separating the iris from the rest of the eye and removing noise from the image. Noises can be from the quality of image capture or the placement of eyelashes, eyelids and reflections. After segmentation, the iris is stored in a specific format. The software product used is MATLAB.

articleTitle: Model for Reengineering of Entrepreneurial Process in Electrical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper presents a re-engineering model covering the three main stages of the entrepreneurial life cycle - start-up, development and termination of a business. The proposed adapted model allows to reveal the instantaneous total risk in the entrepreneurial process. Risk is seen as a deviation of the current state of the environment (its determining factors) from its desired and most favorable state for the entrepreneurial process. Risk measurement is based on the use of semi-quantitative assessments that characterize the impact of risk factors on the development of the entrepreneurial process. In conclusion, results from the application of the model are presented.

articleTitle: Parametric 3D FEM Analysis of an Iron-Cored Coil Thermal Properties
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper presents parametric analysis of the thermal properties of an iron-cored coil using 3D FEM modelling. The investigated sample belongs to low power transformer or chokes device's family. The assembly includes a coil wounded on a spool and a laminated EI-type ferromagnetic core. The investigation is focused on how the thermal resistances, presented in the equivalent scheme for the device temperature analyses, depend on geometrical parameters and thermal properties of materials involved.

articleTitle: Application of the virtual laboratory for schoolchildren's functional literacy development
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The article reveals approaches of various types of virtual (VR) laboratory and provides evidence of the effectiveness of using them in schoolchildren's teaching. The necessity of dialogue between teachers and developers of educational VR programs is proved. The article proposes a new approach to the development of learning tasks. This approach is important for the design and development of virtual learning environments and their wide use in the educational process. It will also allow developing tasks aimed at the natural science functional literacy development of schoolchildren in close to real conditions.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Analysis of Technological and Efficiency Development in Photovoltaic Systems
