publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Renewed tendencies towards the development of technologies for green energy for circular economy and sustainable development of business and society had led to a new increased interest towards renewable energy technologies and more specifically those based on photovoltaics. One of the major points related to renewable energy is system efficiency. Considering this the current paper suggests a base bibliometric analysis of authors and their citation relation throughout the span of several periods, demarked by the fluctuating interest in renewable energy. The analysis is based on the software application VOSviewer, as bibliometric data is extracted from the internationally recognized databases. The paper presents a detailed evaluation and summary of the presented analysis.

articleTitle: The Psychology Of Sustainable Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Sustainable energy is a critical aspect of the global effort to reduce carbon emissions and mitigate climate change. Psychology plays a vital role in achieving that goal because the decision-making processes of individuals and communities are influenced by psychological factors that affect their attitude towards sustainable energy. This article will examine psychological factors influencing sustainable energy and how they affect the behavior and decisions of individuals, organizations, and policymakers.

articleTitle: Social Wellbeing and Energy Poverty
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The report examines the question of how energy poverty is linked to the achievement of social well-being for society and the individual. The interrelationships between the various sectoral policies regarding the problem of energy poverty are outlined and up-to-date information is presented regarding the political decisions in Bulgaria to deal with this problem.

articleTitle: Operational Torque Characteristics of Innovative Coaxial Magnetic Gear's Constructions
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper a thorough investigation of the torque of innovative coaxial magnetic gear's constructions has been made. The innovations of the construction of the coaxial magnetic gear is that permanent magnets between the steel segments of the magnetic gear are situated. Three variants of the polarity of the permanent magnets between the steel segments have been made. The torque of the three variants of the magnetic gear's constructions is investigated. A time dependent Finite Element Method (FEM) model has been implemented. Additional magnets will obtain greater magnetic torque due to increased magnetic flux. Different magnets orientation must improve flux modulation and flux detachment in high speed rotation. Increased cogging has also been observed. Comparison of the results for all constructions has been made.

articleTitle: Attention Detection in Virtual Educational Laboratory
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the development of the attention detection software module for a virtual educational laboratory. The change of attention concentration was recorded within 5 minutes according to a proof-reading sample of Bourdon with a neurointerface Mind Link in the studies carried out by the authors. A methodology for assessing attention exhaustion has been developed. The authors of the article succeeded to determine growth, decline and constant level of attention without a graphical representation of an attention level change with an artificial intelligence algorithms.

articleTitle: Power-to-Heat in district heating systems — A case study for Sofia's DHC
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This article contains an assessment of the potential and economic results of Power-to-Heat application in Sofia's district heating system. A concept for hybrid systems is proposed including electric boilers powered by RES electricity which displaces gas demand in the existing gas-fired CHPs. The report includes an analysis of heat demand and RES generation profiles, and proposes a method for choosing an optimal electricity supply mix.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Insulation Composite Materials Electrical Properties in Liquid Nitrogen
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper we are presenting experimental measurement results of capacitance and dissipation factor of composite materials at liquid nitrogen temperatures. Samples of twenty-six composite insulation materials are tested at room and cryogenic temperatures. Investigated materials are put in liquid nitrogen bath setup which is made by 3D printing. The experimental setup consists of an insulating material sample which is put between two metal electrodes in liquid nitrogen environment. Capacitances and impedance angle <tex>$\theta$</tex> are measured between two electrodes at 2.5 mm distance with RLC meter at 1 kHz. From measured angle <tex>$\theta$</tex> and capacitance the dissipation factor and permittivity are calculated for each sample.

articleTitle: Business Process Reengineering Model for Wind Park
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: In this paper, an adapted re-engineering model is proposed and the same is applied to assess the degree of satisfaction of business process needs occurring in a wind park. The assessment is based on semi-quantitative estimates characterizing the indicated satisfaction in the analyzed park in Bulgaria. To determine the level of satisfaction is indicated, a comparative analysis was applied between estimates from the analyzed wind park and estimates from a reference wind park. The detected deviation between the analyzed park and the reference park is considered as a satisfaction gap and therefore a risk for the development of the analyzed park. The paper presents the results of the application of the proposed adapted re-engineering model.

articleTitle: Energy Resources as a Factor for Stability in Europe in the 20th Century
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The purpose of the report is to prove that in the industrial age the main factor affecting international relations is the issue of energy resources. This is determined by the orientation of heavy metallurgy in developed industrial countries towards replacing fuels. In support of this thesis, fateful events for Europe and the world are traced, at the center of which is the rivalry between the great European powers for hegemony on the continent. Against this background stands out the Franco-German enmity, the escalation of which during and after the First World War led to the permanent USA practice of intervention on the continent and, after the Second World War, to European integration.

articleTitle: Multi-Criteria Analysis Approaches for Energy System Development Scenario — Review
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This article provides an overview of possible multi-criteria analysis approaches for evaluation of energy development scenarios. The studied material is mainly intended as discussion on the MCA methods' importance, classification, types and main steps which a basic multi-criteria decision problem procedure typically includes. Based on an extensive literature review, we show that long-term energy planning and multi-criteria decision-making are enriched by highlighting relevant alternatives, reflecting external uncertainties and applying different evaluation criteria.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing the Public Sentiment on Nuclear Energy Investment in European Union Member States
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The article aims to analyze key factors that influence public sentiment on nuclear energy investment in the European Union (EU) member states. The research employs a mixed-method approach, combining quantitative and qualitative data from Eurobarometer surveys, interviews, and referenda. Its primary contribution lies in an analysis of the most statistically-significant correlations, discovered through a Bayesian softmax regression model, to predict prevalent European member states' sentiment on nuclear energy. The sentiment is a categorical variable with three possible values: Positive, Neutral, and Negative, and the model predicts the probability distribution of the sentiment. The model provides insight into the impact of different factors on the nuclear energy sentiment and can be useful in identifying key statistical correlations. It has implications for the future development of nuclear energy policy at both the member state and pan-European level. The findings suggest that economic considerations play a significant role in shaping public opinion on nuclear energy investment and point to the existence of a “two-track” Europe, divided along economic and energy dependence fault lines.

articleTitle: Impact of Decarbonisation in the Energy Sector on Low-Voltage Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: This paper examines the transformation of low-voltage distribution networks (LVDN) driven by the European Union's (EU) energy decarbonisation policies. The impact of the new generation is assessed through the concept of hosting capacity (HC). The drawbacks of the classical approach are discussed, and alternative approaches are reviewed. Engineering solutions to mitigate the negative impact of a new generation in LVDNs are discussed. Policies related to decarbonisation that are yet to be implemented are also covered.

articleTitle: Oxyhydrogen — an Overview of the Technology, Application and Production Factors
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: The present paper provides and overview of the oxyhydrogen gas as a possible clean source of energy and decarbonization solution. The oxyhydrogen gas characteristics, construction and types of oxyhydrogen electrolyzers, oxyhydrogen production and the gas application in different areas are reviewed. The main factors, which are connected with the electrode geometry and characteristics, electrolyte and power source parameters and influence the production rate and efficiency of the production of oxyhydrogen are analyzed and compared.

articleTitle: Integrating NARX Neural Network with K-S Test for Accurate Partial Discharge Detection in Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 18th Conference on Electrical Machines, Drives and Power Systems (ELMA)
abstract: Condition monitoring of transformers is crucial in preventing unexpected outages and equipment damage due to the ageing and deterioration processes. However, the traditional methods of setting alarm thresholds are problematic due to the dynamic changes in the operational and environmental conditions of transformers. This paper proposes a novel approach to partial discharge (PD) detection by integrating the Nonlinear Auto Regressive eXogenous (NARX) neural network with the Two-Sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov (K-S) test for online monitoring of a partial discharge index, called Peak to Average Power Ratio (PAPR). The proposed model aims to enhance the accuracy of PD detection by increasing the chances of identifying normal process behavior and reducing false positive alerts. The results of the study demonstrate the effectiveness of the NARX-K-S integration in improving the accuracy of partial discharge detection and provide a new direction for the condition monitoring of transformers.

Author Keywords: Nonlinear Auto Regressive eXogenous (NARX) neural network
